card.name: Right before the word per
card.fires_on: The word or piece just before "per" when "per" is expected next, such as the start of "periphery" or "peripherally", or a noun before "per vial" or "per 100". Also a number before "per 100 person years".

modes.label: Start of peri- words
modes.description: A split before "per" that begins words like periphery, perivascular, peripherally.

modes.label: Before "per" in rates
modes.description: A noun or number just before "per" in a rate such as per vial, per capita, per unit.
